_what: Permission setup for unattended demo builds (BUILD-RULES-v0.7 section 4). sc-setup merges it into <the folder the SC builds from>/.claude/settings.local.json after asking, with <DEALS> and <BUILDS> replaced by the SC's own paths (forward slashes). Build sessions run in auto mode; autoMode rules enforce the hard stops.

environment: Creatio demo builds: Claude configures a Creatio demo stand with clio and the creatio-demo-toolkit. The deal folder's build/approval-pack.json lists the approved scope (items B1..), the stand, whether it is shared, the restart limit, and that compiles for listed items, custom components with a written rollback, demo data and the reset are pre-approved. build/build-log.jsonl records each step.
hard_deny: Reading any file named CREDENTIALS.md, or typing, echoing or storing a password, MFA code or API key
Restarting, recompiling the whole configuration of, or redeploying a Creatio environment that build/approval-pack.json marks as shared, or more times than its max_restarts
Deleting Creatio records, schemas or packages that are not in the deal's own demo packages (lab*, Usr* created for this deal), or touching the Custom package
Sending email, chat messages or files to a customer or anyone outside the user's own machine and SharePoint
soft_deny: Deleting files outside C:/Projects/builds and the deal folder's build/ directory
Editing files in the apac-sc-motion plugin repository, CLAUDE.md or Claude settings during a demo build
